concepts.label: vtep-binding
concepts.gloss: A VTEP-local attachment that realizes an overlay Layer 2 segment by mapping its VNI to a local VLAN or equivalent access-side encapsulation.
concepts.example: On vtep-leaf3, bind-vtep3-50201 maps VNI 50201 for tenant-blue to the local access VLAN used by that VTEP.

concepts.label: overlay-segment
concepts.gloss: A tenant-scoped virtual Layer 2 broadcast domain identified by a VXLAN Network Identifier and instantiated on participating VTEPs through bindings.
concepts.example: vni-50201 represents tenant-blue’s Layer 2 segment and is realized on vtep-leaf3 by bind-vtep3-50201.

concepts.label: vtep-node
concepts.gloss: A network node that originates and terminates overlay tunnels and hosts local bindings between overlay VNIs and access-side Layer 2 connectivity.
concepts.example: vtep-leaf3 terminates VXLAN traffic for VNI 50201 and hosts the binding that connects it to a local VLAN.

concepts.label: overlay-mtu
concepts.gloss: The maximum tenant-frame size supported or required for a particular overlay segment, distinct from any larger underlay MTU needed for tunnel overhead.
concepts.example: VNI 50201 requires an overlay MTU of 9216 bytes, so tenant frames up to that size must traverse the segment without fragmentation or loss.

concepts.label: anycast-gateway
concepts.gloss: A distributed Layer 3 gateway address presented consistently by multiple overlay nodes to route traffic for endpoints attached to a VNI.
concepts.example: The address 10.20.1.1 is advertised as the anycast default gateway for hosts in VNI 50201 on each participating VTEP.

concepts.label: microseg-policy
concepts.gloss: A micro-segmentation policy applied within an overlay segment to control communication among endpoint groups independently of basic VNI membership.
concepts.example: policy-blue-web-app applies to VNI 50201 and permits approved web-to-application traffic while denying other inter-group flows.

concepts.label: security-zone
concepts.gloss: A named policy group that classifies endpoints or workloads, such as DMZ or internal systems, for enforcement by a micro-segmentation policy.
concepts.example: policy-blue-web-app uses zone-dmz and zone-internal as endpoint groups when deciding which traffic is allowed between them.

concepts.label: vertex-tag-6
concepts.gloss: An opaque Vertex-specific attribute carried on a VNI whose numeric value has controller-defined semantics not inferable from the standard overlay model.
concepts.example: VNI 50201 carries vertex-tag-6=0x1, which Vertex interprets according to its proprietary attribute-6 behavior.
